description: This Java interface defines the key for a MetadataHeader, including methods for parsing, creation, and comparison, specific to the Ditto framework's metadata header system.

classes.name: MetadataHeaderKey
classes.description: Interface representing a key for a Metadata header in Ditto, providing methods for parsing, creation, and comparison.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a character sequence to produce an instance of MetadataHeaderKey, with validation according to specific rules.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of MetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer path, with validation for correctness.

methods.name: appliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Indicates whether this key's associated metadata should apply to all JSON leaves affected by a command.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer path of this key, possibly modified if applicable to all leaves.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this key as it would appear in DittoHeaders.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this key with another MetadataHeaderKey based on their paths, considering wildcards as less than specific paths.
